comments.author: boriskenn
comments.body: MEMORY LEAK: this cache grows on every unique key with no eviction — in production it will eat the heap alive within a day. Unbounded growth here is a ticking bomb!

comments.author: hildamarr
comments.body: Walked through it together: the store is a bounded LRU capped at 500 entries with eviction metrics on the dashboard, and the load test holds flat at the cap. Growth is bounded by construction — resolving as invalid.
